decisions.title: Named Agents over Anonymous Workers
decisions.description: Each subagent has a name (oracle, explore, librarian, etc.) and a documented specialty. Users and the orchestrator can reference agents by name, building a mental model of the team.
decisions.alternatives: Anonymous worker threads would be simpler but harder to reason about. Named agents make the system self-documenting.

zh.title: 命名代理优于匿名 Worker
zh.description: 每个子代理有名字和文档化的专长。用户和编排器可以通过名字引用代理，建立对团队的认知模型。
zh.alternatives: 匿名工作线程更简单，但难以推理。命名代理让系统自我文档化。

decisions.title: Each Subagent Gets Fresh Context
decisions.description: Subagents start with a clean message history containing only their task-specific system prompt and instructions. They don't inherit the parent's conversation, preventing context pollution.
decisions.alternatives: Shared context (passing the full history) would give subagents more background but at the cost of token waste and potential confusion from irrelevant messages.

zh.title: 每个子代理有独立的上下文
zh.description: 子代理从干净的消息历史开始，只包含其任务特定的系统提示和指令。它们不继承父会话，防止上下文污染。
zh.alternatives: 共享上下文会浪费 token 并可能因无关消息导致混淆。
